paper_metadata.title: Effect of Ni addition on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Co-Cr-Al oxide dispersion strengthened superalloys

evidence.quote: In order to increase the ductility of alumina-forming Co-Cr-Al oxide dispersion strengthened (ODS) superalloys, Ni alloying was introduced into the superalloys.

Co-Cr-Al ODS superalloys with the nominal chemical composition of Co-20Cr-15Al-xNi(x = 0, 10, 20 and 30)-0.4Y 2 O 3 – 0.6Hf (at.%) were prepared using mechanical alloying (MA) and spark plasma sintering (SPS)

attributes.location: fcc phase close to deformation zones

evidence.quote: an interesting finding is that deformation nanotwins can be observed in the fcc phase close to the DZs

conditions.test_method: microhardness tester, load 0.1 kgf, holding time 10 s

evidence.quote: the highest microhardness with the value of 580 Hv was obtained from the 0Ni sample
0Ni showed a very low elongation of 0.23%, while 30Ni possessed an increase to 6.75%

the addition of 10 Ni increased the ultimate tensile strength (UTS) to 1.8 GPa

mechanisms.name: Ni addition expanding solid solution limit of Al

evidence.quote: Ni addition suppressed the formation of the B2 phase based on the change in the relative intensity
Preferential fracture starting from B2 phase in the tensile test was confirmed.
Deformation-induced nanotwins in the fcc phase was observed, which is expected to improve the strength and ductility of the Ni-added Co-Cr-Al ODS superalloys.
